summary.headline: An introductory Java OOP course taught faithfully to its own scope: every market skill demanded by ≥30% of backend postings (SQL, REST APIs, Postgres, Docker, AWS, Linux, Git, CI/CD, microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, OAuth/JWT, Redis, Prometheus, etc.) sits in databases, web protocols, infrastructure, or DevOps domains entirely outside this course's depth bound, and no slide partially covers them — so under the 'extend partial coverage only' rule there are no actionable in-scope gaps to surface.
